name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

# A new push to a PR makes the in-flight run obsolete; cancel it rather than queueing.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_NET_RETRY: 3

# Every cargo invocation below passes `--locked`: Cargo.lock is committed, and a build
# that silently re-resolves to a different dependency graph than the reviewed one is
# exactly the supply-chain drift this bot cannot afford.

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: build, clippy, test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Pinned to the version the Dockerfile builds with, so a lint or a
      # compile error cannot pass CI and then fail in the release image.
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: 1.94.0
          components: clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --locked --all-targets

      # Deliberately without `-D warnings`: the crate carries pre-existing lint debt
      # (`too_many_arguments` in tasks/execute_relay.rs, a few collapsible ifs, a
      # manual checked division in indexer.rs). Clearing that is its own change; until
      # then this step still fails on anything clippy classifies as an *error*.
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets

      - name: Unit tests
        run: cargo test --locked --lib

      # Integration tests are named individually on purpose. A bare `cargo test` would
      # also pick up the devnet suites (bridging, happy_path, reconcile, startup_checks,
      # validator_integration, challenge_edge_cases), which need two anvil nodes with
      # the Vea contracts deployed on ports 8545-8547 and would hang here. Everything
      # listed below runs entirely in-process against the fault-injection transport.
      - name: Integration tests (no devnet)
        run: |
          cargo test --locked --test task_store_test
          cargo test --locked --test rpc_failure_modes_test

  docker:
    name: docker build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      # Build only - nothing is pushed. This validates that the release profile still
      # compiles inside the pinned rust:1.94.0-slim-bookworm image and that the
      # runtime stage still finds the binary it copies.
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: vea-validator:ci
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
